import math

def main():
    a, b, n = map(int, input().split())
    best = float('inf')
    x = y = 0
    for j in range(1, n + 1):
        base = (j * a) // b
        for i in range(base - 1, base + 2):
            cur = abs(i / j - a / b)
            if cur < best:
                best = cur
                x = i
                y = j
    g = math.gcd(x, y)
    print(f"{x // g}/{y // g}")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
